theater: 西奈半島、加薩走廊與戈蘭高地

battle.name: 第三次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 西奈半島、加薩走廊與戈蘭高地
battle.brief: 一九六七年六月五日至十日的六日戰爭，以色列先用空軍奪取制空，再以裝甲縱深突破，六天內攻佔西奈至蘇伊士運河、加薩走廊、約旦河西岸與戈蘭高地。卡面的一八六〇年加特林機槍未曾在戰場出現，但它確立的旋轉多管火砲原理，正是當年各國戰鬥機普遍裝用的二十毫米火神式機砲的族譜。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰方分成兩大集團。以色列一方由總理戴維·本-古里安掌舵，國防部長摩西·達揚主持軍務，參謀總長伊扎克·拉賓擬定作戰計劃，全軍分中央司令部（拉賓兼任）、南方司令部（莫爾德凱·馬克萊夫）、北方司令部（海姆·巴爾萊夫）三個系統運作，開戰時作戰部隊約十三萬五千人，戰時動員至約二十萬，民間預備役陸續補入。阿拉伯聯盟沒有統一司令部：埃及由總統加姆·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾親自統率，總參謀長穆斯塔法·塔哈在六月八日座機於西奈上空被以色列空襲擊落身亡，參謀部實際由空軍司令侯塞因·穆巴拉克主持，投入第七師與第四裝甲師等部；敘利亞由總統福阿德·里法伊與總參謀長阿卜杜勒·卡里姆·納哈維指揮，投入第三、第九、第十步兵師及裝甲部隊；約旦由國王侯塞因一世與參謀長阿里·塔拉維奈統率，以第四十裝甲師等部為主；伊拉克由陸軍當局派第五師進駐阿里什一線，未及接戰便撤回；沙烏地阿拉伯、科威特、突尼西亞與阿爾及利亞提供名義或間接支援。聯合國部隊早在五月十五日已撤出加薩與西奈，戰後只留聯合國中東特別委員會的停火觀察小組。
countriesEn: The belligerents fell into two main groupings. On the Israeli side David Ben-Gurion steered the government as prime minister, Moshe Dayan ran defence affairs, and Chief of Staff Yitzhak Rabin drew up the operational plan; the army worked through three systems — Central Command (Rabin), Southern Command (Mordechai Maklef) and Northern Command (Haim Bar-Lev) — with about 135,000 men in the line at the outset, roughly 200,000 once mobilisation was complete, and civilian reservists filling the ranks as the fighting went on. The Arab coalition had no unified command. Egypt was under the personal direction of President Gamal Abdel Nasser, whose chief of staff Mustafa Taha was killed on 8 June when his helicopter was shot down by an Israeli air strike over Sinai, so the general staff was in practice run by air force commander Hosni Mubarak, with the 7th Infantry Division, the 4th Armoured Division and other formations committed. Syria was directed by President Fuad al-Rifai and chief of staff Abd al-Karim al-Nahawi, fielding the 3rd, 9th and 10th Infantry Divisions together with armoured brigades. Jordan was under King Hussein I and chief of staff Ali Tarawneh, centred on the 40th Armoured Division and similar units. The Iraqi army authorities sent the 5th Division to the El Arish line and pulled it back without ever reaching the battle, while Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Tunisia and Algeria gave nominal or indirect support. United Nations forces had already withdrawn from Gaza and Sinai on 15 May, and by the end of the war only the small ceasefire observer teams of the UN Special Committee on the Middle East were left in the area.
people: 以色列方面最具決定性的一步，是本-古里安在五月二十二日內閣會議上拍板先發制人；達揚以寧可由我們先動手、也不讓對方先動手的理由主導國防會議；拉賓則力主速戰速決，六月一日接掌中央司令部後，把西奈的推進分成南北兩路。空軍參謀長莫爾德凱·霍德策劃代號「晨曦」的先制空襲，計畫在參謀部作戰處反覆演練。裝甲方面由阿里·沙龍指揮第一四三裝甲師打通「中國農場」缺口，北方由約瑟夫·多里率軍突破「敘利亞的支柱」防線，空降兵旅長莫塔·古爾在中國農場一役陣亡。情報線上，阿哈隆·亞里夫五月三十一日在沙姆沙伊赫與納賽爾會面，換得敘利亞自戈蘭撤退的承諾，這次接觸也讓雙方看清了開戰的邊界。阿拉伯方面，納賽爾六月三日宣布辭職，卻在大規模集會後留任，軍方權力隨之上升；穆巴拉克在空軍覆沒後收拾殘局，薩達特時任國會議長、刻意保持低調，總參謀長穆斯塔法·塔哈陣亡使參謀部一時群龍無首；敘利亞總統福阿德·里法伊與約旦國王侯塞因一世各自尋求停火，兩國都把責任推給埃及。聯合國秘書長吳丹與聯合國軍司令恩西奧·西拉斯窩自六七年二月起率聯合國部隊駐守加薩與西奈，五月十五日奉命撤出，成為整場戰爭最關鍵的前奏。
peopleEn: The most decisive act on the Israeli side was Ben-Gurion's decision in the cabinet on 22 May to strike first; Dayan drove the defence council on the argument that it was better for Israel to open the shooting than to let the other side do it; and Rabin pressed for a short war, taking command of Central Command on 1 June and splitting the advance across Sinai into a northern and a southern thrust. Air force chief Mordechai Hod planned the opening strike under the code name Focus, rehearsed again and again in the operations section of the general staff. On the armoured side Ariel Sharon led the 143rd Armoured Division through the gap at the Chinese Farm, in the north Yosef Dori broke the Pillars of Syria defensive line, and paratroop brigade commander Motta Gur was killed in the action at the Chinese Farm. On the intelligence side Aharon Yariv met Nasser at Sharm el-Sheikh on 31 May and obtained a promise that Syria would pull its troops back from the Golan; the contact also showed both sides where the line of war lay. On the Arab side Nasser announced his resignation on 3 June but stayed on after massive demonstrations, and the army's political weight grew accordingly; Mubarak picked up the pieces after the air force was wiped out, Sadat was then speaker of the national assembly and kept deliberately low-profile, and the death of chief of staff Mustafa Taha left the general staff leaderless for a time. Syrian president Fuad al-Rifai and Jordan's King Hussein I each sought a separate ceasefire, and both blamed Egypt for the war. UN Secretary-General U Thant and UNEF commander Ensio Siilasvuo had held the United Nations force in Gaza and Sinai since February 1967 and were ordered to withdraw on 15 May, and that withdrawal became the most critical prelude to the whole campaign.
kits: 卡面這件一八六〇年的加特林機槍本身未曾在任何一條戰線上出現：它是以人力手搖帶動六根管的早期速射武器，每分鐘約二百至四百發，在美國內戰之後已退出一線作戰。但它確立的原理並未斷絕——加特林旋轉多管火砲在一九六〇年代復活為兩個後代：美軍在越南於一九六七年投入使用的三七管M134迷你砲機槍，每分鐘三千至五千發；以及同出加特林族譜的M61火神式二十毫米機砲，每分鐘約五千發，是同年美軍F-4E等機型的標準機砲，以色列在六十年代後期才大量引進，以軍幻影II系列配的是三十毫米德法加機砲，二十毫米口徑主要靠機炮艙與M3式機砲。地面火力方面，最接近卡面器材的是FN MAG七點六二毫米通用機槍與M2HB十二點七毫米重機槍，分別架在坦克、裝甲車與車載機槍座上，步槍是FAL與加利，衝鋒槍是UZI。坦克方面，以軍有百夫長、M48A1、M60A1、AMX-13與超級謝爾曼，埃及有T-34/85、T-54/55、T-62、IS-3M與M48A2；反戰車靠一百零六毫米M40無後坐力砲與約三百發SS.10有線指令導彈；砲兵以二〇三毫米榴彈砲對上埃及的五十七毫米ZiS-2與一二二毫米榴彈砲，敘利亞另有卡車裝BM-13火箭砲。海軍方面，以色列只有兩艘英制勇敢級驅逐艦與一批魚雷快艇，埃及靠蚊子級快艇與遠海巡邏，六月八日薩菲外海短兵相接，驅逐艦埃拉特號則在十月被魚雷擊中，那是戰後延續的衝突。
kitsEn: The 1860 Gatling gun on the card never appeared on any front: it was an early rapid-fire weapon turned by hand crank, six barrels driven by a man, firing some two hundred to four hundred rounds a minute, and it had long since left first-line service after the American Civil War. The principle it established, however, did not die out. The Gatling rotary multi-barrel gun resurfaced in the 1960s in the shape of two descendants: the 37-barrel M134 minigun, which the US Army put into service in Vietnam in 1967 at three to five thousand rounds a minute; and the M61 Vulcan 20 mm cannon, itself a direct member of the Gatling family and also rated at about five thousand rounds a minute, standard on US types such as the F-4E in the same year — a gun Israel only took in quantity in the late 1960s, since the Israeli Mirage II series carried 30 mm DEFA cannon and the 20 mm calibre was supplied mainly by gun pods and M3-type guns. On the ground, the closest thing to the weapon on the card was the FN MAG 7.62 mm general-purpose machine gun and the M2HB 12.7 mm heavy machine gun, mounted respectively on tanks, armoured vehicles and vehicle machine-gun mounts, with the FAL and Galil as rifles and the Uzi as the submachine gun. In tanks, Israel fielded the Centurion, M48A1, M60A1, AMX-13 and Super Sherman, while Egypt had the T-34/85, T-54/55, T-62, IS-3M and M48A2; anti-tank work fell to the 106 mm M40 recoilless rifle and some three hundred SS.10 wire-guided command-to-line-of-sight missiles; in artillery, 203 mm howitzers faced Egypt's 57 mm ZiS-2 and 122 mm howitzers, while Syria also had truck-mounted BM-13 rocket launchers. At sea Israel had only two British-built Daring class destroyers and a flotilla of torpedo boats, while Egypt relied on Mosquito class fast attack craft and long-range patrol boats; the encounter of 8 June off Safi was brief, and the destroyer Eilat was struck by a torpedo in October, in a conflict that continued after the war had ended.
tactics: 以色列的戰術核心是先制空、再縱深的兩段式。第一段是六月五日上午七時四十五分的「晨曦」空襲：以軍以單一密集編隊自地中海低空突入，轉向後同時攻擊埃及的十餘處空軍基地，地面待擊的阿拉伯飛機損失約三百架，制空權在數小時內易手，空戰首日以軍僅損失十架。第二段是地面進攻：中央司令部把三個方向壓在同一日推進，第七與第八裝甲旅沿「薩拉姆」走廊——薩拉姆、比爾·吉夫加法、阿布·阿格伊拉——直插蘇伊士運河，第一四三裝甲師由「中國農場」缺口切入，第六傘兵旅空降佔領陶菲克港與德維索伊爾，蘇伊士運河在六月八日被封鎖，距開羅約一百五十公里；北方由約瑟夫·多里的部隊在六月九日夜以空降兵突破「敘利亞的支柱」陣地，翌日佔領庫奈特拉；約旦戰線上以軍先擊退「卡爾梅勒」反攻，裝甲部隊當日進入耶路撒冷，隨後控制東耶路撒冷與約旦河西岸。以軍作戰機的活動半徑受十五架加油機限制，深遠打擊只能短程出擊，一九六六年曾有兩架幻影IIJA飛越加油航線直擊亞歷山大，其中一架因耗油過量中彈墜地，即著名的「超級童子」事件。阿拉伯方面的縱深阻擊在失去制空權後失去耳目，裝甲部隊被分割包圍，縱深梯次與地堡只在短暫火力準備下有效；聯盟各國沒有統一無線電網，各軍按本國時間表自行停火。補給上，以軍靠薩拉姆走廊的卡車隊與供水管線維持，埃及軍則因燃料與飲水不足放棄多處據點。
tacticsEn: Israeli tactics rested on a two-stage formula: first seize the air, then strike in depth. Stage one was the Focus air strike at 07:45 on the morning of 5 June: a single dense formation came in low over the Mediterranean, turned inward and struck more than ten Egyptian airfields at once, some three hundred Arab aircraft were destroyed on the ground, and air superiority changed hands within hours, with Israel losing only ten aircraft in the air fighting that first day. Stage two was the ground offensive: Central Command pressed all three axes forward on the same day, the 7th and 8th Armoured Brigades drove up the Salam corridor — Salam, Bir Gifgafa, Abu Ageila — straight at the Suez Canal, the 143rd Armoured Division came through the gap at the Chinese Farm, and the 6th Parachute Brigade landed to take Port Tewfik and Deversoir, the canal being sealed on 8 June at a point about a hundred and fifty kilometres from Cairo. In the north, Dori's forces broke the Pillars of Syria positions with a night parachute landing on 9 June and took Quneitra the following day. On the Jordanian front the Israeli army first threw back the Karameh counterattack, armour entered Jerusalem the same day, and East Jerusalem and the West Bank came under control in the days after. The reach of the Israeli fighters was limited by fifteen tanker aircraft, so deep strikes had to be short-range sorties; in 1966 two Mirage IIJAs had flown beyond the tanker track to strike Alexandria, one of them being shot down after burning out its fuel in flight, the so-called Superkid incident. Arab defence in depth lost its eyes and ears once air superiority was gone, armoured groups were cut off and surrounded, and fortified positions held only against brief concentrations of artillery. The coalition had no common radio net, and each army stopped fighting on its own national timetable. On logistics, Israel sustained itself with truck columns and water pipelines along the Salam corridor, while the Egyptian army abandoned positions for want of fuel and drinking water.
data: 戰役自一九六七年六月五日上午七時四十五分開火，至六月八日雙方基本停火、六月十一日零時停火生效，全程六天，地面戰鬥主要集中在首日。以軍作戰部隊約十三萬五千人，戰時總動員約二十萬；阿拉伯聯盟合計約二十七萬至三十萬人。坦克方面，以軍有約八百輛（作戰狀態約四百輛），埃及約一千二百至一千五百輛，敘利亞約四百五十至六百輛，約旦約三百輛；六日內的損失一般記為以軍約十至十五輛，埃及約二百五十至三百輛，敘利亞約一百至一百五十輛，約旦約一百五十至二百輛。飛機方面，以軍作戰機約二百五十架，埃及約四百二十架，敘利亞約一百架，約旦與伊拉克合計不足八十架；六月五日空襲中地面被毀的阿拉伯飛機約三百架，以軍全役損失十九架，首日十架。傷亡方面，以軍陣亡約七百八十至九百人、負傷約二千六百人；埃及軍陣亡約五千至一萬人，敘利亞約三千至四千五百人，約旦約二千七百至三千七百人，伊拉克極少，阿拉伯聯盟合計一般估計一萬至兩萬人。被包圍的埃及軍在西奈於停火前後分批投降，以軍在埃拉寧附近一次即收容數千名埃及俘虜，約旦軍亦有多人被俘。距離上，西奈半島南北長約二百公里，拉法至蘇伊士運河公路約二百一十公里，戈蘭前線自邊境至庫奈特拉約二十公里，以軍戰鬥機受加油機限制，縱深打擊多在一百至一百五十公里內。火力產能上，一八六〇年加特林機槍每分鐘二百至四百發，M61火神式機砲每分鐘約五千發，M134迷你砲機槍每分鐘三千至五千發。
dataEn: The campaign opened at 07:45 on 5 June 1967 and ran to six days, with both sides largely ceasing fire on 8 June and the ceasefire taking effect at 00:00 on 11 June; the ground fighting was concentrated in the first day. Israel had about 135,000 men in the line and mobilised to roughly 200,000 in all; the Arab coalition together numbered about 270,000 to 300,000. In tanks, Israel had some 800 (about 400 operational), Egypt about 1,200 to 1,500, Syria about 450 to 600 and Jordan about 300. Losses over the six days are generally given as 10 to 15 tanks for Israel, 250 to 300 for Egypt, 100 to 150 for Syria and 150 to 200 for Jordan. In aircraft, Israel had about 250 combat types, Egypt about 420, Syria about 100, and Jordan and Iraq together fewer than 80; roughly three hundred Arab aircraft were destroyed on the ground in the strike of 5 June, while Israel lost nineteen aircraft over the whole campaign, ten of them on the first day. In casualties, Israel lost about 780 to 900 dead and some 2,600 wounded; the Egyptian army lost about 5,000 to 10,000 dead, Syria 3,000 to 4,500, Jordan 2,700 to 3,700 and Iraq very few, the Arab coalition total being generally estimated at 10,000 to 20,000. The Egyptian troops encircled in Sinai surrendered in batches around the ceasefire, the Israelis taking several thousand Egyptian prisoners in one go near El Arish, and Jordanian troops were also captured in numbers. As to distances, the Sinai peninsula is about two hundred kilometres from north to south, the road from Rafah to the Suez Canal about two hundred and ten kilometres, and the Golan front about twenty kilometres from the border to Quneitra; the reach of Israeli fighters was limited by their tankers, so deep strikes generally fell within 100 to 150 kilometres. As to rate of fire, the 1860 Gatling gun fired two hundred to four hundred rounds a minute, the M61 Vulcan about five thousand, and the M134 minigun three to five thousand.
cause: 起因是敘利亞局勢與埃及動員交疊而成。敘利亞在一九六六年派兵進入約旦境內，與以色列長期對峙；四月到五月，以色列空襲敘利亞在戈蘭與貝卡谷地的陣地，四月二十六日「卡普蘭事件」中以色列空軍一架A-4在敘利亞被擊落，一名飛行員死亡、兩人被俘，達揚索還遺體的強硬姿態令氣氛更緊，敘利亞在戈蘭集結重兵。五月十五日埃及完成向三角地帶與西奈的大規模調動，徵召預備役並驅走駐紮的聯合國部隊，發生拉巴阿事件；同一天納賽爾發表演講，宣布封閉蒂蘭海峽，稱以色列的封鎖已構成「侵略」並揚言動用自衛權。美國國務卿魯斯克同日表示美國不認為蒂蘭海峽具有國際海峽地位，被外界讀作默許；蘇聯則要求阿拉伯聯合國家提出譴責以色列的決議而未果。以色列情報界評估，納賽爾的計畫正是要把封鎖海峽變成開戰理由，同時挽回一九五六年蘇伊士戰敗的聲望、坐大自己在阿拉伯聯盟中的領導地位；本-古里安於五月二十二日決定先發制人，以一次空襲摧毀阿拉伯空軍再解決地面問題。
causeEn: The cause lay in the overlap of the Syrian situation and Egyptian mobilisation. Syria had sent troops into Jordan in 1966 and stood in long confrontation with Israel; between April and May Israel raided Syrian positions on the Golan and in the Bekaa Valley, and on 26 April the Kaplan incident, in which an Israeli A-4 was shot down over Syria with one pilot killed and two captured, left Dayan's demand for the return of the bodies as a matter of national pride and drove Syria to mass troops on the Golan. On 15 May Egypt completed its major move of forces into the Sinai and the Gaza approaches, called up reservists and drove out the United Nations troops stationed there, producing the Raba incident; the same day Nasser delivered the speech announcing the closure of the Straits of Tiran, describing the Israeli blockade as aggression and threatening to exercise the right of self-defence. US Secretary of State Dean Rusk said the same day that the United States did not consider the Straits of Tiran to be an international strait, which was read abroad as acquiescence, while the Soviet Union failed to get the Arab League to pass a resolution condemning Israel. Israeli intelligence assessed that Nasser's plan was precisely to turn the blockade of the strait into the casus belli while recovering the standing lost at Suez in 1956 and enlarging his own leadership of the Arab bloc. On 22 May Ben-Gurion decided to strike first, reasoning that one air strike could destroy the Arab air force and settle the ground question afterwards.
impact: 這場戰爭改寫了中東的權力版圖。以色列實際控制的面積由戰前約二萬平方公里增至戰後約八萬七千平方公里，佔領西奈至蘇伊士運河、加薩走廊、約旦河西岸與戈蘭高地，並控制約旦河上游、拿撒勒湖與加里利湖，長期水資源問題因此部分解決；同年六月底以色列把法律適用範圍擴至東耶路撒冷，一九八〇年再以法律宣布耶路撒冷為統一首都。埃及損失西奈與運河收入，蘇伊士運河自一九六七年起長期封閉，納賽爾的泛阿拉伯主義聲望重挫而軍方地位反而上升，阿拉伯各國互責，聯盟協作機制名存實亡，一九六八年起巴勒斯坦武裝開始跨境襲擊。國際層面，美國第六艦隊進入地中海，蘇聯與中國分別發出警告，這是冷戰期間超大國最接近正面對峙的一次，也是安理會在十一月通過第二四二號決議的背景，該決議提出不容以戰爭取得領土，成為日後處理佔領區的法律基礎。軍事上，以色列確立了制空權優先、裝甲縱深突破與速戰速決的樣板，阿拉伯各國則大規模擴軍並轉向蘇聯供應，埃及自一九六八年起接受蘇聯軍事顧問與地空導彈援助。
impactEn: The war redrew the power map of the Middle East. The territory actually controlled by Israel grew from about 20,000 square kilometres before the war to roughly 87,000 after it, with the occupation of Sinai down to the Suez Canal, the Gaza Strip, the West Bank and the Golan Heights; taking the upper Jordan, Lake Tiberias and Lake Kinneret partly solved the long-running water problem. At the end of June that same year Israel extended the reach of its law to East Jerusalem, and in 1980 it declared by statute that Jerusalem was the unified capital. Egypt lost Sinai and the revenue of the canal, the Suez Canal stayed closed for years from 1967, Nasser's pan-Arab standing was badly damaged while the army's position rose, the Arab states blamed one another and the machinery of the coalition became nominal; from 1968 Palestinian armed groups began cross-border attacks. On the international stage the US Sixth Fleet entered the Mediterranean while the Soviet Union and China issued warnings of their own, one of the closest approaches to a direct confrontation between the superpowers in the Cold War, and the background to Security Council Resolution 242 passed that November, which laid down the principle that territory should not be acquired by war and became the legal basis for handling the occupied territories ever since. Militarily, Israel set the template of air superiority first, armoured breakthrough in depth and a war of short duration, while the Arab states expanded their armies on a large scale and turned to Soviet supply; from 1968 Egypt took Soviet military advisers and surface-to-air missile assistance.
result: 停火經美國居中斡旋與聯合國中東特別委員會安排，於六月十一日零時生效，埃及與敘利亞的抵抗實際在六月八日已停。阿拉伯聯盟解體：埃及在西奈的一個整師被切斷，退路斷絕後在停火前後陸續投降，以軍佔領包括西奈在內的全部戰區；約旦失去耶路撒冷與河西岸，軍隊損失慘重，國王侯塞因一世責備埃及開戰前未與他商議；敘利亞失去戈蘭，但政權未倒，反而把敗績歸咎於埃及的單獨行動。蘇伊士運河封閉、埃及的封鎖與後來的游擊戰，使雙方在整個七〇年代陷入另一場消耗戰，一九七〇年埃及軍隊在戈蘭方向被清剿，一九七三年贖罪日戰爭隨之而來。對以色列而言，六天的速勝換來廣闊但難以防守的領土：山地、沙漠與人口稠密的約旦河西岸各有各的難題，戰後的邊境防衛工程、戈蘭定居點與對約旦河的管制，都是這場勝利留下的長尾。
resultEn: The ceasefire, arranged through US mediation and the UN Special Committee on the Middle East, took effect at 00:00 on 11 June, Egyptian and Syrian resistance having in practice stopped on 8 June. The Arab coalition came apart. An entire Egyptian division in Sinai was cut off and, its retreat route closed, surrendered in batches around the ceasefire, and the Israeli army occupied the whole battlefield including Sinai. Jordan lost Jerusalem and the West Bank, its army was badly mauled, and King Hussein I blamed Egypt for going to war without consulting him. Syria lost the Golan, but its government did not fall; on the contrary it blamed the defeat on Egypt's unilateral action. The closure of the Suez Canal, the Egyptian blockade and the guerrilla war that followed kept both sides locked in a different kind of war of attrition through the whole of the 1970s: the Egyptian army was cleared out of the Golan direction in 1970, and the Yom Kippur War of 1973 followed. For Israel the six-day rush to victory bought broad but hard-to-defend territory; the mountains, the desert and the crowded West Bank each brought their own problems, and the frontier works, the Golan settlements and the control of the Jordan that followed the war are the long tail left behind by that victory.
